name: layout_view_fields
description: One catalog field a view binds, in order, with its role: title, subtitle, price, image, detail or group.
lifecycle: Replaced with the whole definition on every save; deleted with its area.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the layout (tenant key).
Catalog area whose view binds the field.
Zero-based order in the view, 0 to 7.
Bound catalog field; it cannot be deleted or archived while bound.
How the view shows the field: title, subtitle, price, image, detail or group.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, area_id) REFERENCES layout_areas(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The area belongs to the same company; bindings are deleted with it.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, field_id) REFERENCES catalog_fields(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The field belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while bound.
A view binds at most eight fields.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['title'::character varying, 'subtitle'::character varying, 'price'::character varying, 'image'::character varying, 'detail'::character varying, 'group'::character varying])::text[])))
constraints.Purpose: Roles come from a closed set.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX layout_view_fields_field_idx ON public.layout_view_fields USING btree (company_id, field_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds the layouts that bind a field.
